title: CubeCraft Items
description: CubeCraft Items transforms your standard 2D Minecraft items into stylish, vibrant 3D cubes! Give your inventory a fresh, geometric, and modern look.
body:
Tired of the same old flat 2D sprites? CubeCraft Items reimagines the Minecraft inventory by turning items into miniature 3D cubes. This pack gives the game a unique "isometric" and consistent aesthetic that fits perfectly with the blocky nature of Minecraft.

Whether you're looking at your ores, ingots, or tools, every item now feels like a physical object you can hold!

 Key Features
3D Cube Models: Every item is represented as a stylized, textured cube.

Vibrant Colors: Enhanced textures that make items pop in your inventory and on the ground.

Consistent Design: A uniform look across all item types for a cleaner UI.

Performance Optimized: Lightweight models that won't lag your game or drop your FPS.
